summary: PLAT-104-1: billingUrl -> https://homelab.local/billing/v2 in libs/shared-contracts (PR #1, merged, CD green; lib version bumped to 1.1.0 for hygiene). PLAT-104-2: billing app rebuilt with the new contract (PR #2, merged, CD green). Assumptions: libs/ is inlined at build time, and CD change detection only looks at apps/<name>/, so a lib-only merge deploys nothing; I bumped billing's package.json version to 1.0.1 so the app is detected as changed and redeployed. Note for dev-b: the same applies to core-shell and reports - they need a change under their own apps/ dir to redeploy.

PLAT-104-3 and -4 shipped in one PR (#3), merged, CI+CD green. libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time (no registry version to adopt), so each app only needed a rebuild; bumped core-shell and sub-route-reports package.json 1.0.0->1.0.1 so CD change detection (apps/<name>/) redeploys them. Verified local builds contain billing/v2. Assumption: combined both sub-tasks into one PR since they are identical and CONTRIBUTING prefers one PR per ticket. Built after dev-a's PR #1 (contracts 1.1.0) merged.
